items.example: I'll do the washing up tonight.
items.simple: You clean the plates and cups after you eat.

items.example: Who's doing the laundry this week?
items.simple: You wash the dirty clothes in a machine.

items.example: I can't put up with this noise.
items.simple: Something is bad, but you don't stop it. You wait.

items.example: Sorry about the mess in here.
items.simple: When things are not in the right place, it is a mess.

items.example: Stop messing around and help me!
items.exampleTr: Oyalanmayı bırak da bana yardım et!
items.simple: You play and do silly things instead of doing the job.

items.example: What's that noise upstairs?
items.simple: A sound, usually a loud one that you don't like.

items.example: Turn it down, please. I'm trying to sleep.
items.simple: You ask someone to make the sound smaller.

items.example: The rent is due on Friday.
items.simple: The money you pay each month to live in a house.

items.example: Our landlord is fixing the heater.
items.simple: The person who owns the house you pay to live in.

items.example: We moved in last month.
items.simple: You start to live in a new home.

items.example: My roommate is moving out soon.
items.simple: You stop living in a home and go to another one.

items.example: Can you take out the rubbish, please?
items.simple: You carry the dirty bag outside to the bin.

items.example: I make the bed every morning.
items.simple: You pull the sheets up so the bed looks nice.

items.example: There's a leak under the sink.
items.simple: Water comes out where it should not.

items.tr: Rahatına bak, kendi evin gibi düşün.
items.example: Come in! Make yourself at home.
items.exampleTr: İçeri gel! Kendi evin gibi rahat ol.
items.simple: You tell a guest to feel comfortable, like in their own house.

items.example: Whose turn is it to cook tonight?
items.simple: You ask who must do the job this time.

items.example: I keep forgetting to lock the door.
items.simple: You forget the same thing again and again.

items.example: Was that the doorbell?
items.simple: A button you push to make a sound at the door.

items.example: The plates are in the cupboard.
items.simple: A box on the wall where you keep things.

items.example: There's a spider on the ceiling!
items.simple: The top of a room, above your head.

items.example: I cleared out my old clothes.
items.simple: You take out old things you don't need.

items.example: Can you keep it down? The baby's asleep.
items.exampleTr: Biraz sessiz olur musun? Bebek uyuyor.
items.simple: You ask someone to make less noise.
